title: Potential Difference and Electric Fields
author: 64ba2471daf2a424d4ee3d14
chapter_outcomes: understand that an electric field (force field) is defined as a region where a charged particle experiences a force
understand that electric field strength is defined as E = F/Q and be able to use this equation
be able to use the equation F = Q₁Q₂/4πε₀r² for the force between two charges
be able to use the equation E = Q/4πε₀r² for the electric field due to a point charge
know and understand the relation between electric field and electric potential
be able to use the equation E = V/d for an electric field between parallel plates
be able to use V = Q/4πε₀r for a radial field
be able to draw and interpret diagrams using field lines and equipotentials to describe radial and uniform electric fields
